title: Consolidate Rust Async Backbone
description: Consolidate compose/rs/kit_backbone_async.rs into compose/rs/lib.rs, refactor the async backbone into a properly integrated object-oriented API, extend existing tests only, and verify the Rust package passes.
summary: Consolidated the Rust async kit backbone into compose/rs/lib.rs by ensuring the native-only inline module owns the public backbone API, keeping the authority runtime as KitBackboneAuthority, removing the standalone kit_backbone_async.rs source, and verifying the existing async backbone tests through the full Rust test suite. Updated the remote backbone test path to the current kind-based wire discriminator. Verification: cargo fmt and cargo test from compose/rs passed with 83 passed, 1 ignored.
